answer: In an agent economy, each newcomer posts a small, non-refundable stake in a shared vault shaped like a jade token. Before that stake unlocks, peers must vouch that the agent completed a canyon-deep work trail—real API calls, timed compute, and a yarrow-tagged attest from three unrelated nodes. Fake clones burn the stake and never clear the trail, so mass identities stay expensive while honest agents keep earning.
